name: drag-lint
description: Delphi/Pascal language server backed by the drag-lint index: hover, go-to-definition, find-references, workspace symbols, completion and signature help.

dragLint.engineSource.markdownDescription: The deployed engine this extension MIRRORS FROM -- the same binary the Delphi IDE loads. VS Code does not run it directly (see `#dragLint.engineUpdate#`); it copies it, because a running language server holds an execute lock on its own image, and that lock is what makes `build_draglint_win64.bat` fail to stage a fresh build.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Refresh the private copy when the extension activates (VS Code start, window reload, or the first Pascal file opened) and NEVER mid-session. This is what keeps a live VS Code session from blocking an engine rebuild.
Never refresh automatically. Run **drag-lint: Update Engine Copy Now** when you want it.

Do not use a private copy at all -- run `#dragLint.engineSource#` directly. Restores the pre-1.4 behaviour, in which VS Code and the Delphi IDE always run the identical file AND a live session blocks restaging.
dragLint.engineUpdate.markdownDescription: When the private engine copy is refreshed from `#dragLint.engineSource#`. The copy exists so VS Code can sit a few builds behind on purpose: the Delphi IDE keeps the current engine, and rebuilds are never blocked.

dragLint.serverPath.markdownDescription: Explicit override: an absolute path to a `drag-lint.exe` to run AS-IS. When set, no copy is made and `#dragLint.engineSource#` / `#dragLint.engineUpdate#` are ignored. Leave EMPTY (the default) to use the managed private copy. **If you point this at the deployed path, a live VS Code session will lock that binary and engine rebuilds will fail to stage.**

dragLint.databases.markdownDescription: Optional explicit `--db` paths. Leave EMPTY (the default) to let drag-lint auto-select databases from `drag-lint.json` beside the exe — that is what keeps VS Code pointed at whatever the manifest currently says, including per-project indexes.

dragLint.trace.server.description: Log the LSP conversation to the 'drag-lint' output channel.
